item.title: The Chilling Story Of Aleksandr Akimov, The Soviet Engineer Who Was On Duty During The Chernobyl Disaster
item.description: Aleksandr Akimov was a night shift supervisor at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, and his attempts to mitigate the effects of the reactor explosion in April 1986 left him with such severe radiation sickness that he was dead within two weeks. The post The Chilling Story Of Aleksandr Akimov, The Soviet Engineer Who Was On Duty During The Chernobyl Disaster appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: The Haunting Story Of How Sylvia Plath Died And The Tragic Events That Led Up To It
item.description: Sylvia Plath died by suicide at the age of 30 on February 11, 1963, following a barrage of literary rejections and discovering her husband's infidelity. item.title: The Brave Life And Death Of Lepa Radić, The Yugoslav Partisan Who Was Executed By Nazis At Just 17
